view: PA (recorded); frontal paediatric chest radiograph whose appearance (mandible/teeth included, both scapulae over the lateral lung fields, arms abducted, clavicles projected high) is more consistent with an AP projection. L marker with technologist initials 'DG' at image upper right confirms conventional orientation (image-left = patient-right).
technical_quality: Adequate. Penetration reasonable (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac silhouette). Inspiration slightly shallow to adequate (about 6 anterior ribs above the right hemidiaphragm). Rotation minimal at most (Reader B suggested mild leftward rotation; medial clavicular ends are roughly symmetric about the spinous processes). Both apices and both costophrenic angles are included. Mandible and teeth project above the thoracic inlet without obscuring the apices; scapulae overlie the lateral upper lung fields. Collimated field with unexposed white borders laterally and superiorly and a small dark rectangular film/scan edge artifact at the far upper-left image corner. Earrings were not removed. AP-type projection and shallow inspiration may mildly exaggerate the cardiac silhouette.

suitability_reason: 標記所見（心臟擴大）清楚可見：心影呈球狀擴大、心胸比約 0.54，超過 7 歲兒童正常上限；片上無胸管、引流管、中心靜脈導管、心律調節器或任何治療性裝置，僅見耳環、側別標記與疑似衣物暗扣等體外物；無手術或既往處置痕跡，適合作為首次就診之影像。惟擴大程度屬輕度，AP 投照與吸氣稍淺可能部分放大心影，教學時可提示需結合臨床判讀。
description_zh: 7 歲女童正面胸部 X 光（記錄為 PA，影像特徵較符合 AP 投照），雙臂外展，吸氣稍淺至尚可，無明顯旋轉，穿透度適當。心影呈球狀擴大，位於中央下肺野並延伸至中肺野，心尖偏向左側；心臟橫徑約占胸廓內徑 54%（心胸比約 0.54），以兒童胸寬推估心臟橫徑約 12 公分，超過此年齡層正常上限，惟 AP 投照及吸氣不足可能部分放大心影；上縱膈輪廓略寬，可能與投照條件或殘餘胸腺有關，氣管居中。雙肺野清晰，肺門血管紋理略顯但無 Kerley 線或肺泡浸潤，未見肺水腫、肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利，橫膈輪廓完整，骨骼結構無明顯異常。體外物包括雙側耳垂金屬耳環、影像右上角（病人左側）之 L 側別標記（DG）與其上方之圓形不透光標記盤，以及左肩區一小圓形物（疑為衣物暗扣或電極貼片）；未見胸管、引流管、導管或心律調節器等任何治療性裝置。
